stories.title: Directors of Gurugram hub arrested in real estate fraud case
stories.summary: Four people, including directors of 32nd Avenue, were arrested for allegedly cheating a buyer of ₹32.45 lakh. Police say the shop was sold as 40 square feet, despite measuring only 9.88 square feet. The accused are currently on three days of police remand.

stories.title: CREDAI Chennai to challenge marshland construction limits
stories.summary: CREDAI Chennai is heading to the Supreme Court to contest a National Green Tribunal order that restricts construction within one kilometre of the Pallikaranai marshland. The association claims the restriction affects over one lakh landholders, with some land titles dating back to 1911.

stories.summary: Clean air, green spaces and improved connectivity are making Dehradun an attractive luxury housing destination for homebuyers from Delhi-NCR. For years, the definition of luxury housing in the National Capital Region has revolved around spacious layouts, premium specifications, landscaped surroundings and an extensive range of lifestyle amenities. However, changing environmental

stories.summary: The Supreme Court has quashed criminal proceedings against L&T Finance and Edelweiss Asset Reconstruction Company in a dispute involving Raheja Developers, drawing a distinction between a builder's RERA violations and the criminal liability of its lenders. However, the judgment brings renewed attention to the developer's troubled financial history, disputed land

stories.title: Ahmedabad retail rents reach record highs
stories.summary: Retail rents in Ahmedabad have climbed to as much as ₹42 lakh per month for prime locations. Real estate consultants attribute the surge to high demand from large-format retailers and limited supply. Owners are maintaining high contract rates to keep property values elevated.

stories.title: Premium homes drive south India’s housing market
stories.summary: Bengaluru: Demand for residential housing remains steady in key southern India cities despite West Asia conflict and slowdown in IT hiring. According to executives in the real estate sector and market experts, inventory level has risen in some cities though demand for premium properties remained sound. “We have not seen

stories.title: CREDAI Chennai to move Supreme Court against 1km construction restriction around Pallikaranai marshland
stories.summary: The Confederation of Real Estate Developers’ Associations of India (CREDAI) Chennai has expressed its deep disappointment over the order passed by the Madras High Court on the Pallikaranai Ramsar issue. Having heard the matter for over nine months, the court’s decision to refer it to the Supreme Court has come

stories.title: Karnataka government targets 15 lakh free residential sites
stories.summary: The Karnataka government plans to distribute 15 lakh free residential sites and build one lakh houses during 2026-27. The project, titled Bhooguarantee, has an estimated budget of ₹2,241 crore. The first phase will focus on developing five lakh sites at a cost of ₹1,000 crore.

stories.title: Court cancels tax sale after county ignores death notices
stories.summary: A Pennsylvania appeals court set aside a $109,000 tax sale of a home after the county continued sending notices to a deceased owner. Officials failed to investigate mail returned with the word deceased, despite the owner dying in 2019 and her son in 2023.

stories.summary: Dubai's real estate market presents a compelling investment opportunity, offering significantly lower property prices and higher rental yields compared to major Indian cities like Mumbai and Delhi, with strong potential for future appreciation. Key Points - Dubai real estate prices are significantly cheaper than in Mumbai and Delhi, with prime

stories.title: Danube Properties claims Dubai real estate is cheaper than Mumbai
stories.summary: Danube Properties claims Dubai real estate is cheaper than Mumbai and Delhi, offering prime locations for $1,000 per square foot. The company projects significant rate appreciation over the next three to five years. Dubai is described as having prices that are still very reasonable and achievable.

Supreme Court rules on joint ownership for unmarried couples
stories.summary: The Supreme Court has ruled that real estate registered to one partner can be recognized as joint property for couples living together without a marriage certificate. The decision clarifies how property is divided in de facto family relationships, depending on when the assets were acquired.

stories.title: Korean landlords offer rent-free periods to mask vacancy
stories.summary: Commercial landlords in Korea are offering up to one year of free rent to attract tenants as vacancy rates hit record highs. The strategy aims to maintain high contract rents to prevent property valuations from falling. The market is currently prioritizing optics over cash flow.

stories.title: India retail leasing hits four-year high
stories.summary: Retail leasing across India's top seven cities reached 9.36 million square feet in the first nine months of 2026, a 5.6% increase over the previous year. JLL attributed the performance to economic factors and premiumisation. Retailers remain bullish despite a 41.6% decline in new mall supply.

stories.title: Bank of America signs major Hyderabad office lease
stories.summary: Bank of America's Indian entity has leased 10.1 lakh square feet of office space at Mindspace Cyberabad in Hyderabad. The 12-year agreement covers 11 floors and is expected to generate approximately Rs 1,450 crore in rent. Payments are scheduled to begin in January 2027.

stories.title: Felix Plaza highlights shift toward experiential retail
stories.summary: New Gurugram's Felix Plaza is positioning itself as a multi-purpose destination to attract consumers who seek experiences beyond simple transactions. As quick commerce changes daily purchasing habits, physical retail spaces are increasingly focusing on leisure and utility to encourage longer visits from families.

stories.title: Retail leasing demand outpaces new supply
stories.summary: India's retail real estate market recorded its strongest nine-month leasing performance in four years, with 9.36 million square feet leased. JLL noted that demand has strengthened despite headwinds, including a 41.6% year-on-year decline in new mall supply and elevated retail inflation.

stories.title: The building formerly known as Block 37 teases a new era - Crain's Chicago Business
Auckland fringe offices see vacancy drop
stories.summary: Vacancy rates for Auckland's Karangahape Road and Newton office hubs fell by 3.3 and 2.2 percentage points between March and September. Colliers research suggests the areas are benefiting from the City Rail Link, which opened in September and improved public transport accessibility for businesses.

stories.title: Khan Market remains India's most expensive retail street
stories.summary: New Delhi's Khan Market has retained its position as India's most expensive retail street, with annual rents reaching $238 per square foot. According to Cushman and Wakefield, rents at the destination increased 14% year-on-year, ranking it 24th globally in retail costs.

stories.title: Orgatec India 2026 focuses on workplace design
stories.summary: The second edition of Orgatec India opened at Mumbai's Jio World Convention Centre, showcasing advancements in ergonomic solutions and smart office technology. The exhibition comes amid a 15% rise in commercial real estate investments, bringing together architects and manufacturers to discuss workplace infrastructure.

stories.title: Cabinet approves Rs 33,660 crore BHAVYA scheme to develop 100 industrial parks - DD News
Warehousing demand exceeds new supply in 2026
stories.summary: India's Grade A and A+ warehousing sector recorded 54 million square feet of absorption during the first nine months of 2026, outpacing new supply of 47.1 million square feet. While overall demand declined 18% year-on-year, the absorption-to-supply ratio remained at 1.1 times.

stories.title: Grade A warehousing absorption stays ahead of supply
stories.summary: India's Grade A and A+ warehousing market saw 54 million square feet of absorption in the first nine months of 2026, exceeding new supply additions by 15%. Total ready stock reached 492.7 million square feet by the end of the third quarter.

stories.title: Cummins India reports data center power demand
stories.summary: Cummins India is reporting strong demand for its power generation equipment, with data centers now contributing 30% to 40% of segment revenue. To offset rising commodity and input inflation, the company is implementing progressive price adjustments across its domestic portfolio.

stories.title: CtrlS to build 150-megawatt data center in Bihar
stories.summary: CtrlS Datacenters has signed a pact with the Bihar government to invest 100 billion rupees in a new data center in Patna. The facility is expected to be operational by 2029-2030 and create 400 direct jobs, joining a wave of infrastructure investments targeting India's AI industry.

stories.title: Warehousing absorption outpaces new supply
stories.summary: The Indian Grade A and A+ warehousing sector recorded 54 million square feet of absorption through September 2026, exceeding new supply by nearly 15%. Total stock reached 492.7 million square feet, even as demand moderated 18% compared to the same period last year.

stories.title: Warehousing vacancy falls as demand moderates
stories.summary: India's Grade A and A+ warehousing sector saw 54 million square feet of absorption in the first nine months of 2026, exceeding new supply by 6.9 million square feet. The national vacancy level fell to 10.5%, which is 80 basis points lower than the previous year.

stories.title: Prayagraj commissioner reviews drainage and temple projects
stories.summary: Divisional Commissioner Dr Lokesh M inspected infrastructure projects in Prayagraj on Saturday. The work includes installing pipelines to resolve waterlogging near the Medical College and improving facilities for devotees at the Hanuman temple. Officials were directed to remove obstructions and complete the work on schedule.

stories.title: Kolkata Metro extension to link New Garia and Sector V
stories.summary: A 4.5-km extension of the Kolkata Metro's Orange Line is nearing completion, aiming to connect New Garia with the IT hub of Sector V in 30 minutes. The project, which adds three stations, is expected to be operational by the end of 2026.

stories.title: Ranchi to use drones for land record mapping
stories.summary: The Ranchi Municipal Corporation plans to use drones to map and verify all city land records. The initiative aims to create a consolidated inventory of civic assets, prevent illegal property transfers and improve urban development planning after officials identified a lack of current data.

stories.title: India's First Bullet Train: Surat-Vapi Route to Open First in 2027, Here's What We Know - News18
Nitish Setu bridge inaugurated in Bihar
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi has inaugurated the Nitish Setu, a six-lane, cable-stayed bridge in Bihar's Vaishali district. The 9.76-km-long project, which includes 10 km of approach roads, cost 4,280 crore rupees to construct. It is named after former Bihar Chief Minister Nitish Kumar.

stories.title: Varanasi Development Authority adopts land-pooling policy
stories.summary: The Varanasi Development Authority has approved a land-pooling policy for township areas in Kallipur, Madhani and Ganjari. Landowners contributing under 10 acres receive 30 percent of their land back as developed plots, while those contributing more receive 50 percent as semi-developed land. Over 55 acres are already pooled.

stories.title: Andhra Pradesh outlines Vision 2047 economic strategy
stories.summary: Andhra Pradesh has launched a Vision 2047 framework to develop the state into an industrial hub. The government plans to create three economic regions centred around Amaravati, Visakhapatnam and Tirupati to attract domestic and international investment, improve infrastructure and generate employment across the state.

stories.title: Infrastructure capital expenditure reaches 12.2 lakh crore
stories.summary: India's infrastructure sector has shifted toward integrated planning over the last 12 years. Public capital expenditure has risen from 2 lakh crore rupees in fiscal year 2014-15 to 12.2 lakh crore rupees in fiscal year 2026-27, supporting large-scale expansion in transport, logistics, housing and water services.

stories.title: NHB Seeks Separate Affordable Housing Loan Category for Tier-II, Tier-III Cities - Realty Plus Magazine
Yeida allots 147 plots to farmers
stories.summary: The Yamuna Expressway Industrial Development Authority has allotted developed plots to 147 farmers whose land was acquired for development projects. The allotment was conducted through a lucky draw process following instructions from the Uttar Pradesh government.

stories.title: Ghaziabad construction sites face pollution fines
stories.summary: The Uttar Pradesh Pollution Control Board has upgraded monitoring mechanisms at construction sites to enforce Graded Response Action Plan curbs. Authorities have levied 1.14 crore rupees in penalties for violations. The board is now watching the sites more closely to ensure compliance with air quality standards.

stories.title: Shimla hotel future sparks political debate
stories.summary: The future of the Peterhoff Hotel in Shimla has become the subject of political controversy. The historic property, which has served as a residence for former chief ministers, remains a point of contention within the state's socio-political landscape as officials debate its ongoing use and management.

stories.title: New York broker indicted over license renewal
stories.summary: New York Attorney General Letitia James announced the indictment of a Bronx real estate broker for allegedly failing to disclose felony convictions on a license renewal application. The 64-year-old operator is accused of falsely claiming no criminal history during the 2024 to 2026 period.

stories.title: Supreme Court rules on RERA and lender liability
stories.summary: The Supreme Court has held that RERA violations by builders do not make lenders criminally liable for a project. Justices Vikram Nath and Sandeep Mehta observed that RERA obligations remain with the promoter, and alleged contraventions cannot sustain prosecution for offences under the Indian Penal Code.

stories.title: Pag-IBIG housing loans increase by 20 percent
stories.summary: State home financing firm Pag-IBIG Fund supported 78,410 homes worth 127.44 billion pesos from January to October 2026. This represents a 20 percent increase in loan releases compared to the same period last year, driven by the government's Expanded Pambansang Pabahay para sa Pilipino program.

stories.title: Real estate stocks decline alongside broader markets
stories.summary: Real estate stocks dipped alongside broader market indices despite a decrease in long-term bond yields. The sector movement followed a general downward trend across various real estate investment trusts and exchange-traded funds as investors reacted to broader economic conditions.

stories.title: Prologis acquires California industrial property
stories.summary: Prologis has acquired the Stratford Ranch industrial property in Perris, California, for 193.15 million dollars. The transaction involves a 1 million-square-foot logistics asset. Investors are currently weighing the acquisition against broader demand and execution trends within the industrial real estate market.

NBFC borrowing costs remain high
stories.summary: Despite a recent retreat in sovereign bond yields, non-banking financial companies continue to face rising borrowing costs. Debt merchant bankers attribute the trend to tighter liquidity, higher bank funding costs and rising credit spreads, noting that lower benchmark yields have yet to benefit corporate borrowers.

Urban Company raises Rs 2,500 crore through QIP
stories.summary: Urban Company raised Rs 2,500 crore via a qualified institutions placement, allotting 16.02 crore shares at Rs 156 each. The issue saw bids exceeding Rs 15,000 crore, or six times the offering size. Mutual funds accounted for over half of the total allotment.

stories.title: Why Rent Growth Is No Longer Covering Operating Costs for Apartment Owners - StreetInsider
Fotello AI is taking over real estate photo editing
stories.summary: AI photo editing software is increasingly used to automate real estate photography, a sector previously reliant on manual, time-consuming edits. Fotello, which advertises with Fstoppers, claims its software can now produce high-quality results from almost any camera, including mobile phones, making some traditional editing workflows obsolete.

stories.title: Product engineering partners look to AI for efficiency
stories.summary: Founders are seeking ways to build software faster without increasing budgets. While AI is now a standard part of the engineering toolkit, firms are increasingly turning to product engineering partners to pair automated tools with human judgment and execution. Access to the same tools remains universal.

stories.title: Vector Building Products acquires Partitions and Accessories
stories.summary: Vector Building Products has acquired Mesa-based Partitions and Accessories Co. to expand its geographic reach and service offerings across Arizona. The acquired firm, founded in 1978, provides specialty products including privacy partitions and operable walls. Financial terms of the transaction were not disclosed.

stories.title: Shotcreting market shifts toward robotic platforms
stories.summary: The global shotcreting equipment market is entering a growth phase driven by tunneling and infrastructure rehabilitation. According to an IndexBox report, the industry is transitioning from manual dry-mix methods to wet-mix and robotic platforms. These systems are intended to improve material consistency and reduce rebound during application.

stories.title: Nanosilica shows potential in industrial concrete
stories.summary: Engineers have demonstrated that integrating nanosilica into self-compacting concrete accelerates compressive strength gain and improves resistance to fluid ingress. While previous research was limited to laboratory settings, this investigation tested the additives within an active industrial plant to evaluate performance in commercial batching and modular production.

stories.title: Shalimar Paints to merge with Infra.Market
stories.summary: Shalimar Paints plans to merge with its promoter, Hella Infra Market Limited, to become an integrated building-materials company. The transaction, approved by the board on November 16, will involve a share swap. The combined entity aims to expand its portfolio and scale within the construction sector.

stories.title: Thanh Hoa continues to find solutions to overcome the shortage of construction materials - Laodong.vn
Construction debris and pollution concerns in Noida
stories.summary: Residents in Noida Sector 51 have reported construction materials being sold from footpaths, contributing to local pollution levels. These activities persist while Graded Response Action Plan measures are in effect, which prohibit the burning of waste and mandate dust control measures such as water sprinkling.

stories.title: Dhaka construction survey identifies concreting gaps
stories.summary: A field assessment of six major infrastructure projects in Dhaka revealed discrepancies between international engineering codes and practical site execution during hot weather. While crews frequently adopt preparatory measures like chilling mixing water, the survey identified significant operational gaps in maintaining concrete quality under direct solar exposure.

stories.title: Shalimar Paints reports FY26 revenue of Rs 19,839 crore
stories.summary: Shalimar Paints recorded pro forma revenue of Rs 19,839 crore and an EBITDA of Rs 1,709 crore for FY26. The company's EBITDA margin reached 8.6 percent, up from 5.6 percent in FY22. Own brands now account for 69 percent of the company's total pro forma revenue.

stories.title: Rock Hill passive house targets net-zero energy
stories.summary: A new home in Rock Hill, Missouri, is designed to produce as much energy as it consumes through rooftop solar panels and an all-electric build. The structure features super-insulated materials and an airtight design. Owners report minimal monthly utility costs beyond basic fees for the property.

stories.title: Sustainable materials reshape Indian renovation market
stories.summary: Homeowners in India are increasingly prioritizing energy efficiency and durability over price when selecting renovation materials. This shift toward sustainable construction is creating new business opportunities for manufacturers and architects offering low-carbon concrete, fly ash bricks, and recycled materials as alternatives to traditional building supplies.

stories.title: Cape Town hotels achieve sustainability ratings
stories.summary: Two hotels at Cape Town’s V&A Waterfront have received 5-Star Green Star SA design ratings. The certification recognizes the use of shared water and energy infrastructure to reduce environmental impact. These projects are among the first in the country to be certified under the new pilot tool.

stories.title: Oxfordshire energy project held up as model for UK
stories.summary: Community-owned renewable energy is being championed as a model for the UK transition to net zero. Westmill Energy has generated over £1 million in community benefit funding for local projects. MPs and council leaders visited the site to see the impact of community-owned clean energy firsthand.

stories.title: El Niño and Bharat: Climate-Resilient Green Housing Plan
stories.summary: The impact of El Niño in Bharat is tied to the weakening of the Southwest Monsoon, which supplies over 70% of the country annual rainfall. Historically, 44% of El Niño years have resulted in below-normal monsoons or severe droughts. Rainfall remains a seasonal variable.

stories.title: Bend Central Library earns highest global green building honor
stories.summary: The Central Library in Bend has received LEED Platinum certification for its design and operations. The building is 100% solar-powered and features furniture made from sustainable wood without glue. The Redmond Library has also received the same recognition for its sustainability efforts.

stories.title: Road Decarbonisation: Why Materials and Mobility Matter
stories.summary: Experts at an Indian Roads Congress session in Hyderabad called for emissions to be addressed across the infrastructure lifecycle. Recommendations include prioritizing public transport, walking, and cycling alongside construction material choices. The goal is to reduce emissions from India expanding road and bridge infrastructure.

stories.title: Marriott’s First Net-Zero Hotel Costs Millions Extra. The Math Could Work. - Forbes
The AI bust is a growing threat to China's economy
stories.summary: China tech-heavy STAR 50 index has tumbled 44% from its summer high, according to Yardeni Research. The downturn threatens President Xi Jinping plans to turn China toward high-tech manufacturing. The bubble has popped, and the market crash is now a moment of real danger.

stories.title: Real estate influencers sued over property ownership claims
stories.summary: New Jersey regulators are suing two real estate influencers accused of raising over $1.5 million for property deals. The complaint alleges the couple promised rental income from properties they did not own and spent investor money on themselves. The state announced the enforcement action on November 20.

stories.title: ‘Buyers are out for blood’: With home sales at a record low, buyers are calling the shots - MarketWatch
U.S. home sales hit lowest level in 25 years
stories.summary: Americans signed fewer contracts to buy existing homes in October than in any month since records began 25 years ago. The Pending Home Sales Index fell 4.7% to 63.0. Contracts were down 16.7% from a year earlier, with declines recorded across all four U.S. regions.

stories.title: Miami's former cocaine corridor becomes luxury destination
stories.summary: Miami is shifting its 5.5 mile waterway from a hub of smuggling and pollution to a luxury real estate destination. Developers are building high-rise towers and waterfront projects. The area currently features a mix of working boatyards, sewage leaks, and new condos.

stories.title: The latest chapter in Texas’ multifamily distress story: Class A and B foreclosures - The Real Deal
Billionaires tear down L.A. mansions to build bigger ones
stories.summary: L.A. wealthiest residents are buying existing homes to tear them down and build larger estates. While the broader housing market slows as mortgage rates climb toward 7%, the ultra-wealthy continue to purchase property. Open lots are hard to come by, so the mansions are disappearing.

stories.title: Housing market shift: 76 metros where home prices are falling - Fast Company
Robbie Williams sells Wiltshire mansion at a loss
stories.summary: Robbie Williams has sold Compton Bassett House for a reported £6.75 million. He originally purchased the seven-bedroom mansion for £8.1 million in 2009. The sale represents a loss of approximately £1.35 million after 13 years of ownership.
